name: local-user-win
description: Practice-box helper (Windows): creates or updates a local account. Vars: USERNAME (required); PASSWORD (optional -- when empty/omitted the account is created with a BLANK password via -NoPassword); FULLNAME (optional); DESCRIPTION (optional); ADMIN_ADD (optional, default 0 -- add to local Administrators); PASSWORD_NEVER_EXPIRES (optional, default 0). Idempotent: an existing account is updated in place (membership/flags re-applied), never recreated.
